ko:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: Google Play feature graphic for the real Android game 우주 정거장 보급소 (Space Station Supply).
Create one polished finished wide 2048 x 1000 landscape banner (exact aspect ratio 1024:500), full bleed opaque background. Reference image 1 is the existing in-game space station and blue planet, image 2 is the real explorer ship, image 3 the real cargo ship. Use them as visual design references, not as a UI screenshot or a literal collage.
The game is a quiet offline turn-based space supply strategy game. Match its clean, simple geometric low-poly/flat 2D illustration, restrained navy #122f41, mint #9de1c9, warm ivory #f1eee3, muted steel-blue and tiny coral accents. No photorealism, no 3D render, no combat.
Composition: confident editorial game cover, a beautiful orbital supply station with ivory dome, blue windows and mint ring in the central-right area, a large subtle blue banded planet behind it, the small explorer and cargo ships approaching on a softly curved orbital route, a few sparse four-point stars. Crisp large shapes, clear silhouette, intentional negative space on the left for the title. The title and station remain in the inner safe area; keep all critical content at least 110 pixels from the outer edges. Background can bleed. Station should not appear inside an app-icon square.
Typography: expertly spaced, large bold friendly Korean sans serif in warm ivory and mint, on two lines. EXACT Korean title text: "우주 정거장" and "보급소". Smaller supporting line below EXACTLY "작은 정거장, 큰 항해". No other text, no publisher logos, no badge, no play button, no CTA, no fake awards, no watermarks, no frame. Make the text impeccably legible and spelled correctly. Beautiful finished commercial illustration consistent with the actual modest game assets, not a promise of a different genre.
en:
Use case: text-localization. Asset type: English Google Play feature graphic, 2048 x 1000 full-bleed landscape.
Edit the supplied finished Korean feature graphic. Preserve its entire illustration, ship and station designs, colors, stars, composition and background. Change ONLY the Korean text area on the left into English marketing typography. The title is exactly "SPACE STATION" on two warm-ivory lines or one if it fits gracefully, and "SUPPLY" on a larger mint line. Supporting line exactly "Small station. Big journeys." in the existing muted sky-blue. Make the typography confident, geometric, clean and well spaced, visually balanced within the existing left text region and no overlap with ships or station. Keep generous safe margins. No Korean text should remain. Do not add any other words, logos, badges, frame, CTA or watermark. Keep the original wide 1024:500 aspect ratio and render the full banner, opaque.
